verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change consistently adds positive, token-scoped verification of private alert destinations across all three affected alert paths. Public, same-repository, half-configured, failed, malformed, and non-boolean visibility results fall back without carrying the private-route token in the standalone alert scripts; worker-pr preserves its established registry-alert token semantics. The new self-tests exercise both the routing helpers and production wiring, including repository/token argument binding and no-probe short circuits. I found no diff-supported correctness, security, or test-vacuity issue requiring changes.
